Definition: Whether credentials are issued free of charge
Comments: NIP registration and the NIP attestation are explicitly free ('L'enregistrement au NIP ou l'établissement de l'attestation du NIP est gratuit'). The cost of the CNIE card itself is not explicitly stated as free in available sources, but the initial NIP enrollment has no charge.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed: the Ministry of Interior page (fetched) states NIP registration/attestation is free, and President Oligui Nguema publicly announced on 24 June 2024 (reported by Beaugas Orain Djoyum/Digital Business Africa) that the CNIE itself would be issued free of charge; a third source (FunnyGabon/AfriScope, 27 June 2024) corroborates that the first CNIE request is free, though it notes renewal fees are not yet clarified by authorities. Value Code 2 (Yes) is confirmed for first-time issuance with two additional corroborating sources; renewal cost remains unconfirmed but does not affect this variable's definition (issuance of credential).

Definition: Age in years at which an individual becomes eligible to register for digital ID
Comments: Eligibility for NIP and CNIE is set at age 16 (from the birthday). The Ministry of Interior official page states: 'Tous les citoyens gabonais âgés de 16 ans (à la date d'anniversaire).' Children under 16 are not yet covered for the CNIE.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed via three independent sources (Ministry of Interior official page; Gabon24, Feb 2025; Agence Gabonaise de Presse, Mar 2024) that NIP/CNIE enrolment eligibility begins at age 16. Per the variable's own scale (1=>17; 2=10-17; 3=6-10; 4=1-5; 5=<1), age 16 falls in the '10-17' band (code 2), not '6-10' (code 3) as originally recorded — the original row's own cited comment (age 16) was mis-mapped to the scale. Value Code corrected to 2.
